title: Compact Roadmap Packet for Monthly Board & Ops Readout
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Produce a concise, slide-and-one-pager style packet for the monthly executive & board readout that clearly ties product roadmap progress to OKRs, operational signals (latency/cost/SLOs), and a prioritized set of exec asks.

Scope:
- One-page executive summary (status, top 3 wins, top 3 risks)
- Roadmap snapshot (next 90 days) with clear owners and rollouts
- OKR progress table with heatmap for leading indicators
- Operational health dashboard summary (tokens/day, p95 latency, cost per token, cache hit rate)
- Risk & mitigation ledger with impact/likelihood and ask to execs
- Decisions & budget asks (if any), including dedicated capacity or cross-org hires

Audience: CEO, VP Eng, VP Product, COO, Head of SRE, Board members, Sales leadership (ops readout subset).

Why now: Monthly cadence requires a compact packet that is quickly consumable by execs and suitable for the board pre-reads. This ticket consolidates data sources, aligns owners, and finalizes the packet for the Mar 2026 exec readout.

Out-of-scope: Detailed engineering runbooks, full dashboards (links provided instead), and tactical sprint-level tracking.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A 1-page PDF executive summary and 6-slide deck uploaded to Drive and linked in the packet. 2) OKR progress table with at least two leading indicators per OKR. 3) Operational health metrics pulled from the Console dashboard and annotated with short commentary. 4) Risk ledger with owners and proposed mitigations. 5) Exec decisions clearly enumerated and assigned to an owner and due date. 6) Stakeholder review (Product, Eng, SRE, Finance) completed and comments resolved.
risks:
- Data freshness: some metrics (cache hit rate, per-route cost) lag by up to 24 hours. Mitigation: snapshot on 2026-03-08 06:00 UTC and note freshness.
- Unaligned ask: finance may push back on additional dedicated capacity without usage forecast. Mitigation: include 90-day demand projection from Dedicated pilot.
- Scope creep: deck could grow beyond 6 slides; enforce summary-first rule.
- Board-level sensitivity: include redaction guidance for customer names or contract-specific numbers.
decisions_needed:
- Approve the recommended Dedicated capacity bump (3x slot days) for the EU pilot (decision by 2026-03-09).
- Ratify temporary budget reallocation for the QoS reliability sprint (one-time reallocation).
- Confirm whether to include sensitive contract-level ARPU numbers in the board pre-read (expected default: exclude; decision by Board).
